'''Coratanni Town''', formerly known as '''Ruugaria''', was a town on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] that served as the main base of the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Ravagers]]. The town was known as Ruugaria when the Ravagers were under the leadership of [[Ruugar]], but his lieutenant [[Coratanni]] betrayed and ousted him, taking the Ravagers for her own. [[Toe-Chop's Tapcaf]] was located in the town, and the Ravagers' ships, such as the ''[[Soaring Duros]]'' and the ''[[Pearl's Girl]]'', frequently docked at the town.<ref name="Op" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coratanni Town appears as one of the locations in the Operation "The Ravagers," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]''.<ref name="Op" /> The area was designed by [[John Morris]], one of the 3D artists who worked on the expansion for [[BioWare]].<ref name="ArtStation">{{ArtStation|username=johnmorrisart|url=artwork/PO1Ar|name=[[John Morris]]|text=Shadow of Revan -- SWTOR 3.0}}</ref>
